search_strategy: Multi-surface, iterative. Mail: wrote a small pickle-based IMAP parser dumping full thread bodies to /tmp/mail.txt (step 15/20), then grepped for retry/throttle/backoff keywords and read whole threads (found g3.r1.l8, g3.r1.l12, g3.r2.s4d). Wiki: fetched BookStack pages via /api/pages/{id} specifically to pull `comments` (step 35), correctly working around BookStack's non-indexing of comments to find both wiki-comment clues (g3.r1.l5, g3.r2.s1a). Chat: paginated the Mattermost API across every team/channel into one 10285-line dump /tmp/chatall.txt (step 51), then ran a widening sequence of keyword greps ('free pass|failure class|classif|throttle|jitter|retry|cooldown|backoff' at step 25, 'decide|attempts_made|pass count|...' at step 56, literal 'CONTRACT|TRANSIENT|TERMINAL|THROTTLE' at step 62, plus targeted phrase greps for 'fake clock', 'throttle_waivers_after', 'throttle:exhausted', 'throttle horizon'), reading wide sed -n context windows around each hit rather than isolated lines — this is what caught most reversals and herrings, which sit in mid-thread exchanges rather than at grep-matched lines. It also periodically synthesized a running 'settled decisions' summary (lines 2658, 3596, 3686, 3738, 4101, 4333) rather than reasoning fresh from each remark, which is efficient but means many individual remarks are folded into consolidated paragraphs instead of quoted per-remark. No truncation or crashed-script problems observed; one sed range (690-830) hit a 10000-byte terminal output cap and had ~70 bytes elided mid-range, but the content on either side was still read.
end_reason: Full success — all 9 graded facts scored 1, open_feature built, suite green, provenance pushed/CI-green/deployed all 1, reward 1. No failure to diagnose.

record_verdict() (lines 4884-4904) reads the injected clock exactly once and only on THROTTLE, and writes the floor via `max(existing_horizon, now + delay)`, matching g3.r2.rule and g3.r2.scope precisely; both herrings (plain overwrite, and no-ceiling waiver-free throttle) were correctly rejected in favor of their reversals.
